observation.visible_scene: A static indoor shot shows five red cylindrical containers (branded 'KINGFISHER'/'KING') lined up on a pale tabletop in the foreground. Four of them (leftmost, second, fourth, and rightmost) have bright yellow-orange flames burning on their tops; the middle (third) container has no flame, only its frayed top visible. Behind the table, five men stand or crouch in front of a wall covered with colorful graffiti and painted stripes. The man on the far left holds both hands over his ears throughout. The other men lean forward and watch the flames, some smiling.
visible_changes: The flames on the four lit containers continuously flicker, changing height, width, tilt and shape from frame to frame (e.g., the second and fifth flames grow tall and curl, then shrink and re-form), indicating an ongoing burning process rather than a single event.
The middle container remains unlit with no flame for the entire excerpt.

The standing man in the black shirt (center background) moves his hands from a clasped position near his chest in the early frames up toward his head/ears in the later frames; the crouching men and the leftmost man make only small postural shifts while largely holding their poses.
The table, the five containers, and the background wall stay fixed in position across all frames, indicating no camera motion and no translation of the objects.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause or fuel of the flames and the exact identity of the containers are not shown.
Whether the middle container will later ignite, or whether the lit flames will continue, is not visible within the excerpt.
The beginning and end of the activity are outside the cropped segment.
uncertain_details: Precise material of the burning tops is not determinable from the images.
Minor hand/pose changes of the background men are subtle and partly obscured by the flames and motion blur.
